children: Jin Xu Discloses Investment in Jinxin Technology Holding Co with 26.5% Stake

Jin Xu, chairman and chief executive officer of Jinxin Technology Holding Co, reports beneficial ownership of a 26.5% stake through Namibox Technology Limited. The Schedule 13D, dated Nov. 20, 2026, reports that Jinxin granted Xu 186,573,452 restricted shares on Oct. 29, 2026, and those shares vested as ordinary shares that day. The grant recognized Xu’s past and future service to the company and added to the shares Namibox holds for him.

Xu and Namibox say they hold the shares for investment purposes and review the investment on an ongoing basis. They report no current plan or proposal for the types of transactions or changes described in Item 4, but reserve the right to adopt plans in the future. They may also acquire additional securities or make other investment arrangements, subject to applicable law.

Namibox Technology Limited is a British Virgin Islands investment holding vehicle wholly owned by Jin Xu. Xu serves as chairman of the board and chief executive officer of Jinxin Technology Holding Co. The filing identifies Xu as a resident of the People's Republic of China.
